turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm selling my car this week. How do I make the photos look good enough?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Wash it first, inside and out, it matters more than any camera trick. Then pick an empty spot with a plain background, like a car park on a Sunday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. I got a letter saying I owe a bit more tax this year.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not fun. Would you rather pay it all at once, or ask about a payment plan to spread it out?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll be talking to Jordan for a little while, so please stay silent until I tell you I'm finished.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Go ahead, you tell the story, you remember it better.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine, but you'll interrupt me anyway.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Jordan, be honest, is this banner too much?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's enormous. It covers the entire window.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I know, but she loves glitter.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: She's turning fifty, not five. Maybe just the gold letters and lose the unicorns?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, you're right. Can you hold that end while I cut it down?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. Go slowly, the scissors are blunt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm back now. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Still deciding about the tax letter?
